They now accept SP as well, so a medal is one line again, a kill popup "+50 SP" joins its kill line, and a "+70 SP" pickup counts as a money row. The new check failed on the old build. - **28.16, 28.13, 28.12:** these are FLAKY-OK. They passed 3 times. Another worker's heavycrest fixture commit had already touched 28.16.
- **19.00, 18.25, 17.86:** these were not flaky. They failed when run alone in a fresh Chrome tab. I retargeted them:
